thread:
Alex K: Heads up — prospect Databank asked for a short bundle proving our IAM posture before legal signs off. Need SSO/SAML configs, MFA enforcement, RBAC matrix, and service account controls. ETA EOD for their VDR. @Marta S can you own?

Marta S: On it. I have the SAML metadata and IdP screenshots. Will also include our MFA policy link. Do we have a canned RBAC matrix for Dedicated tenants?

Tim Ops: Yes — /docs/ops/rbac-dedicated.csv is the one. I'll export a redacted copy for them. Also note: service accounts are short-lived tokens via KMS rotation policy. I'll attach rotation evidence.

Raj Engineer: For SSO, we require IdP-enforced MFA for all interactive users; service accounts use mutual TLS + key rotation. Here's the exact settings we enforce: `saml.assertion.enforce_mfa=true`, `session.max_age=86400`.

Marta S: Putting together attachments: sso-metadata.xml, idp-mfa-screenshots.png, rbac-redacted.csv, service-account-rotation.pdf. Any HIPAA/PCI-specific asks?

Alex K: :thumbsup: Great. Prospect also wants confirmation of least-privilege for cross-tenant access and separation of duties for ops vs eng. Can we include an example policy and the audit log snippet showing a permission change?

Tim Ops: I can grab an anonymized audit log snippet from prod-audit (redacted). Will include timestamped entry + PR link. Note that we don't expose full logs — supply sample rows and SHA256 hash of original to prove authenticity.

Marta S: I'll draft a cover note explaining what each artifact proves and the controls mapping to SIG/CAIQ sections (IAM, Privileged Access). Draft ready for review in ~1hr.

Alex K: @Marta S please cc legal and sales-eng when you post to the VDR. Also add short TL;DR: 'SSO enforced via SAML, IdP MFA mandatory, RBAC enforced by roles in platform, service accounts rotated and limited.'

sig-bot: SIG intake created: SIG-2026-042. Upload link: https://vdr.example.com/sig-2026-042

Raj Engineer: One caveat to call out: Dedicated customers can enable customer-managed IdP in Private — doc will show default is Redwood-managed IdP for hosted. I'll add a note: 'customer-managed vs hosted defaults'.

Alex K: Perfect. Let's get this in before EOD so legal can review. Thanks team.
